Green is evidence only if red was reachable. Make every new instrument fail first. — NOT VISIBLE in a change record. Only running the blind proves the guard can fail; no artefact records that it was run.
A guard must DRIVE its precondition, never observe the ambient environment. — NOT VISIBLE in a change record. Whether a guard drives or observes is a property of its logic, not of its text.

A basis string is code. Compute a claim from state; never assert a universal in prose. — NOT VISIBLE in a change record. This is the largest unenforced class (30 of 98 in the labelled set); FU-262 proposes extending the pre-flight to it.
Refute the round's OWN fix before shipping it, as hard as the code it changed. — NOT VISIBLE in a change record. Adversarial refutation is a process; the artefacts do not record that it ran.

An item closes on its ACCEPT bar. No bar means UNEXAMINED, never nearly done. — NOT VISIBLE in a change record. Whether a bar's clauses match an item's body is a reading, not a parse. An audit can count items with no bar at all; it cannot judge a bar's fidelity.

Write the bar against the DEFECT, never against correct output. A criterion satisfied by the thing being fixed is not a criterion. — NOT VISIBLE in a change record. Judging whether a clause can fail requires reasoning about the code it describes.
Measure each row's LIVE state before building. A row may accuse working code. — NOT VISIBLE in a change record. A row's truth is established by reading the code it points at.
Fix the CLASS once, at the chokepoint — and grep the CALL, not the method name. — NOT VISIBLE in a change record. Identifying the true chokepoint is a reading of the call graph.
A row closes only when EVERY finding in it is fixed. Partial is open. — NOT VISIBLE in a change record. A row's completeness is a reading of its body against the diff.
